title: Per-sample ancestry Q matrix (extract-schema, self-describing)
_doc: Self-describing artifact for per-sample ancestry. The wrapped envelope (schema/produced_by/inputs/samples/Q) lets the artifact survive being moved, archived, or shared without losing its meaning. Multiple producers can emit artifacts conforming to this schema: load_ngsadmix_qopt (loader for static .qopt outputs), ancestry_groupwise_q (server-side run on a sample subset), and any future ancestry tool that outputs the same shape. Downstream consumers don't know which producer emitted the artifact — they just consume the envelope. This is the 'one extract-schema, many activate-schemas' pattern (chat 39 cont., post-step22 design conversation, 2026-05-07).

schema.description: Self-identification. Tools route on this field.

produced_by.description: Provenance: who made this artifact and with what parameters. The tool field is canonical (ngsadmix / popgen_server / future). Params is freeform — different producers carry different metadata (K, run_id, seed, chrom, snp_set, samples_subset, ...).

tool.description: Name of the producing tool / endpoint / loader.

version.description: Tool version, when known. Optional but encouraged.

params.description: Producer-specific parameters. At minimum K is expected; everything else is producer-discretion (run_id, seed, chrom, scope, samples_subset, ...).

K.description: Number of ancestry components. Same K as the producing tool used.

inputs.description: What went IN to produce this artifact. For loaders: file paths. For server-side runs: input artifact references and parameter snapshots. Freeform on purpose; the activate-schema for each producer pins the exact shape.

samples.description: Sample IDs, in the same order as Q rows. The artifact's ground truth for sample identity — never trust upstream samples.txt sidecars after this point; trust this array.

Q.description: Per-sample ancestry proportions. Q[i] is a length-K array for samples[i], values in [0,1], summing to ~1.0 (NGSadmix may drift to 0.999/1.001 due to optimisation tolerance — this is acceptable; downstream consumers normalise if they need exact-1).

_replaces: ancestry_global_q.schema.json (v1_2026-05-06) — that schema described the post-processed shape in a `_post_processed_shape` field but did not have the canonical envelope. Migration: layer entries pointing at the old schema can either point at this v1 instead, or layer entries that emit the old un-wrapped shape can be promoted via the loader (preferred — see shared/loaders/qopt_loader.js).
